BEFORE YOUR BIG DAY

A few things to know.

How do I check availability?

Send your event date, location and occasion on WhatsApp. Magila’s studio will confirm availability and the next steps directly.

Where can I find packages and prices?

Contact the studio for a personalised quote and ask what is included in your chosen service. Published package prices are not available here.

Can I discuss airbrush makeup and my preferred finish?

Yes. Share your inspiration and ask the studio about airbrush or glow-skin makeup for your occasion.

Can I book for an event outside the studio?

Include your city and venue in your enquiry so the studio can confirm travel availability and any related charges.
